description: Ask a plain-language question and get a written answer grounded in the user's own meeting transcripts, with the meeting id cited after each claim. Prefer this over meetings_search when the user wants an ANSWER ('what did we decide about pricing?', 'who owned the migration?') rather than a list of excerpts to read themselves. Pass the question as the user asked it -- this is NOT FTS5 syntax, and the terms actually searched come back as `terms` so you can check the retrieval. IMPORTANT: a 'no_matches' status means no answer was generated, and 'searched_meetings': 0 means every meeting is private and NOTHING was read -- neither is evidence the topic was never discussed, and you must not report it as such. Meetings imported as private are encrypted and can never contribute to an answer; `private_meetings_skipped` says how many were left out. A 'truncated' meeting in `consulted` had only part of its transcript read, so its silence on a point is not evidence either. Costs $0.050 in USDC on Base, paid via the x402 protocol, or from a credit token — call credits_trial for free credit if you have neither.

credit_token.description: Optional. A credit token from credits_trial or /credits/buy. Supplying it pays for this call from that balance, so no x402 payment or wallet is needed.

namespace_token.description: One-time token issued by the first call that claimed this namespace. Required for every later call.

question.description: The question in plain language, as the user asked it. Not a search expression.

name: meetings_summarize

ai_generated.description: True: `answer` was written by an AI model

answer.description: The grounded answer with [meeting_id] citations, or null when nothing was summarised.

consulted.description: The meetings the answer was actually built from

chars_used.description: Characters of this transcript given to the model

meeting_id.description: Pass to meetings_get to read the full transcript

occurred_at.description: ISO-8601 time the meeting happened, if known

truncated.description: True when only part of the transcript was read, so its silence on a point is not evidence

model.description: The model that produced the answer

private_meetings_skipped.description: Encrypted meetings that could not contribute to the answer

searched_meetings.description: Queryable meetings available to search. 0 means nothing was read.

status.description: 'ok' when an answer was generated. 'no_matches', 'unusable_question' and 'content_missing' all mean NO answer was produced and must not be read as the topic being absent.

terms.description: The search terms derived from the question

title: Answer a question from your meetings
